articles.summary: Gold price advances on Thursday after reaching a daily high of $4,019, but retreats below the $4,000 mark even though the US Dollar and US Treasury yields tumbled. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades with gains of over 0.10% at around $3,985.
articles.title: Gold holds near $4,000 as US shutdown, layoffs boost safe-haven demand

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) tumbled 400 points at its lowest on Thursday, falling to its lowest valuation in nearly two weeks as equity indexes were crushed underfoot by a broad pivot out of AI tech stocks.
articles.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average falls 380 points on Thursday as AI stocks drop

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: Banco de Mexico (Banxico) decided to cut interest rates by 25 basis points to 7.25%, in a 4-1 vote split, with Deputy Governor Jonathan Heath voting to keep rates unchanged at 7.50%.
articles.title: Banxico cuts rates to 7.25%, signals possible pause in easing cycle

articles.author: Pablo Piovano
articles.summary: The US Dollar (USD) added to Wednesday’s small correction, slipping back to multi-day lows in the context of a widespread recovery in the risk-associated galaxy. In the meantime, the US federal government shutdown extended further, hitting a record with still no solution in sight.
articles.title: FX Today: US flash U-Mich gauge and the Canadian jobs report come to the fore

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: EUR/USD recovers some ground on Thursday, post gains of 0.45% after bouncing off daily lows of 1.1486 as the Greenback weakened. A soft jobs data in the US increased speculation for a Fed rate cut at the December meeting. The pair trades at 1.1545 at the time of writing.
articles.title: EUR/USD climbs as weak US jobs data fuels Fed cut bets

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) continues to hold on the weak side against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, finding the brakes enough to slow a near-term one-sided backslide, but not enough to stage a meaningful technical recovery.
articles.title: Canadian Dollar struggles to end bearish slide on Thursday

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: The USD/JPY pair slumps to near 153.05 during the early Asian session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) faces some selling pressure as the US government shutdown extends further, hitting a record with still no solution in sight.
articles.title: USD/JPY tumbles to near 153.00 as US government shutdown woes persist

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem said late Thursday that he saw upside risks to inflation.
articles.title: Fed’s Musalem: Sees upside risks to inflation
